description: Admin improvements group B: dashboard analytics charts (recharts, already installed by FEAT-001), scheduled publish (migration 007), paper tags display on PaperCard and detail page. Also adds the CSP frame-src 'self' update to next.config.mjs needed by the full-screen viewer from FEAT-002. Independent from FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 except FEAT-001 foundation.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/007_scheduled_publish.sql: ALTER TABLE public.papers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS publish_at timestamptz;
Create supabase/migrations/008_tags.sql: ALTER TABLE public.papers ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}';

Note: src/types/database.ts and src/lib/validations.ts were already updated in FEAT-003 to include archived, publish_at, tags columns. Verify these fields exist before proceeding; if FEAT-003 has not run, add them here instead.

Create src/app/api/cron/publish/route.ts: GET handler. Read header 'x-cron-secret'. Compare against process.env.CRON_SECRET. If mismatch return 401. Use createAdminClient(). Query papers to publish: .from('papers').select('id,title').eq('status','draft').eq('archived',false).not('publish_at','is',null).lte('publish_at',new Date().toISOString()). For each paper: .from('papers').update({status:'published',publish_at:null}).eq('id',paper.id). Fire-and-forget log: fetch('/api/admin/log',...,{action:'paper_scheduled_published',details:{id,title}}). Return { published: count }.

Edit render.yaml: add CRON_SECRET to the web service envVars list (sync:false). Add a cron service entry: `- type: cron
  name: publish-scheduled-papers
  runtime: node
  schedule: '*/15 * * * *'
  buildCommand: echo done
  startCommand: >
    curl -sf -X GET $NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL/api/cron/publish -H 'x-cron-secret: '$CRON_SECRET
  envVars:
    - key: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
      fromGroup: past-questions
    - key: CRON_SECRET
      fromGroup: past-questions`. Note: render.yaml cron syntax uses 'startCommand' as the command to run on schedule.

Create src/components/DashboardCharts.tsx: 'use client'. Import from recharts: ResponsiveContainer, LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, BarChart, Bar, PieChart, Pie, Cell, Legend. Props: `{ downloadsData: {date:string; downloads:number}[]; courseData: {code:string; count:number}[]; levelData: {level:string; count:number}[] }`. Render three charts in a grid `grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 mt-8`: (1) LineChart (downloads over time): title 'Downloads (last 30 days)', ResponsiveContainer height=200, Line type='monotone' dataKey='downloads' stroke='#1d4ed8' strokeWidth=2 dot=false. XAxis dataKey='date' tick fontSize=10. (2) BarChart (top courses): title 'Top 5 courses by papers', layout='vertical', height=200, Bar dataKey='count' fill='#7c3aed'. YAxis dataKey='code' type='category' width=60 tick fontSize=10. (3) PieChart (papers by level): title 'Papers by level', height=200, Pie dataKey='count' nameKey='level' innerRadius=40 outerRadius=80. Cell colors: ['#1d4ed8','#7c3aed','#0ea5e9','#10b981','#f59e0b']. Legend. No dark: classes anywhere.

Edit src/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx: (a) After the existing Promise.all, add data aggregation for charts. For downloadsData: use recentPapersRes or a separate query. Query: `const { data: allPapers } = await db.from('papers').select('downloads, updated_at').gte('updated_at', new Date(Date.now()-30*24*60*60*1000).toISOString())`. Build last-30-days date array, sum downloads per day bucket. (b) For courseData: `const { data: pubPapers } = await db.from('papers').select('course_id, courses(code)').eq('status','published')`. Group by course code, count, sort desc, take top 5. Cast courses as CoursesRow. (c) For levelData: `const { data: levelPapers } = await db.from('papers').select('level').eq('status','published')`. Group by level, count. (d) Import DashboardCharts dynamically: `const DashboardCharts = dynamic(()=>import('@/components/DashboardCharts'),{ssr:false})`. (e) Render `<DashboardCharts downloadsData={downloadsData} courseData={courseData} levelData={levelData} />` below the existing stats grid, before 'Top papers by downloads' section.

Edit src/components/PaperCard.tsx: add tags display. Below the semester badge: `{paper.tags && paper.tags.length > 0 && (
{paper.tags.slice(0,3).map(tag=>({tag}))}
)}`. The `paper.tags` field now exists on PapersRow — no type cast needed.

Edit src/app/(public)/papers/[id]/page.tsx: in the meta grid, add a tags row if paper.tags?.length > 0: `{paper.tags && paper.tags.length > 0 && (
Tags
{paper.tags.map(tag=>({tag}))}
)}`

Edit next.config.mjs: in the frame-src CSP header value, add `'self'` to allow the /view/[id] route to work (full-screen viewer) and to allow the PWA cached pages. Change: `"frame-src https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://*.supabase.co"` to `"frame-src 'self' https://challenges.cloudflare.com https://*.supabase.co"`
